title: Financial Responsibility Filings (SR-22 / FR-44): Restoration Charge on a Reinstatement Refiling
content:
A refiling restoration charge is added to the refiling fee of a Financial Responsibility Filings (SR-22 / FR-44) reinstatement refiling, which replaces a certificate whose SR-26 was transmitted for a cancellation of its since-reinstated backing term. It follows how the backing term's coverage was restored, read from the length of its most recent lapse.

**Length of the lapse.** The calendar days from the term's lapse start date through its lapse end date, both days counted. Both dates are on the record of the backing Owner Auto Policy term or Named Non-Owner Policy term.

**Charge**

- Reinstatement after a lapse of more than 3 days: 5.00 added.
- Reinstatement after a lapse of 3 days or fewer: 2.00 added.
- Reinstatement without a lapse: no refiling restoration charge.

**Inputs, judgement and outputs (hypothetical dates)**

| Lapse start date | Lapse end date | Length | Charge |
|---|---|---|---|
| day 10 | day 12 | 3 days | 2.00 |
| day 10 | day 13 | 4 days | 5.00 |
| day 10 | day 10 | 1 day | 2.00 |
| none recorded (reinstated without a lapse) | none recorded | no lapse | none |
